on_unmapped_default: warn+skip (unrecognized QuickSight visual type — dropped with a loud per-visual warning, never silently emitted)
description: QuickSight Definition.Sheets[].Visuals[] visual type -> Sigma workbook element kind. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for build-workbook-from-quicksight.rb's KIND / QS_FALLBACK / QS_UNSUPPORTED dispatch. Three row classes: (1) NATIVE — a row with no `unsupported_reason` maps directly to a Sigma kind (goes into KIND); Gauge/Funnel/TreeMap are native-dispatch approximations (Sigma has no gauge/funnel/treemap element, so they reuse kpi-chart / bar-chart) and carry a `notes` rationale. (2) FALLBACK — `fallback:true` + `unsupported_reason`: Sigma has no native kind, so the visual is DATA-MIGRATED as `sigma` (table/bar) with a loud warning (goes into QS_FALLBACK + QS_UNSUPPORTED). (3) DROP — `sigma:null` + `unsupported_reason` and no fallback: no underlying dim+measure to migrate, so the visual is dropped with a loud warning (goes into QS_UNSUPPORTED only). All three are already loud; this catalog makes the mapping data-driven and cited.

rows.notes: Mapped to donut-chart in code only when DonutOptions.ArcOptions.ArcThickness is present and != WHOLE (compositional).
Sigma scatter axis is a GROUPING axis; the builder binds it to a hidden grouped source (compositional).
pivot-table columnsBy/rowsBy sorts are not spec-expressible (warned + skipped).
Sigma has no gauge element kind; a gauge surfaces a single value -> kpi-chart (mirrors the PBI builder).
Sigma has no funnel element kind; category+measure reads as bars -> bar-chart.
Sigma has no treemap element kind; category+measure -> bar-chart.
Region NAME (state/country/city/zip) -> Sigma region-map; regionType inferred from the geo column name (compositional, region_type_for).
region-map by default; becomes point-map in code only when an explicit latitude+longitude field pair is present (compositional, latlong_pair).

rows.unsupported_reason: Sigma has no waterfall element kind; approximated as a bar-chart of the category totals
rows.notes: Data-migrated (dims+measures) as a bar-chart with a loud per-visual warning.
